subtitle.en: All 4 chapters — discovering that Jesus is supreme over everything!

description.en: Paul wrote to a church he'd never visited, but his message rings just as true today: Jesus holds everything together, lives inside every believer, and is worth putting off our old selves to follow with our whole hearts. Eight adventures through all four chapters of Colossians — from the supremacy of Christ to a family that prays and finishes well together.

title.en: Faith, Love, and a Prayer for Wisdom
The Mystery: Christ Lives in You!
Rooted, Built Up, and Set Free!
Don't Let Anyone Trap You with Rules!
Put Off the Old, Put On the New!
